question: Across all 30 sealed V9 cases, after exact row, source-generator, target-contract, graph-path and complete verified-traversal validation, how often does persistent current-node frontier action end in its selected departure, another verified departure, or a same-node loop merge?
method: Bind the exact finalized 90-case source and four frozen source generators. Validate every row, current/final node, frontier target contract, path, graph update and complete traversal interval. Match every inter-node event to exactly one verified traversal and classify the preceding persistent frontier attempt. Historical target eligibility is proven by the frozen observed-only planner contract because final append-only snapshots do not contain stub creation timestamps.
baseline: No-GT V9 mechanism audit only. It does not change the preregistered comparison, whose primary baseline remains original M-TARE.

user_authorization.scope: One immutable read-only Gate-6 V1R2 mechanism audit after exact 90-case source finalization and seal binding.
user_authorization.confirmation_reference: Standing autonomous authorization for the fixed paper scope; the agent may choose the best in-scope option without repeated approval prompts.

acceptance_criteria: The sealed source has exactly 90 V2-PASS cases and 30 V9 cases.
The source run spec and local checkout match all four frozen source-generator paths and SHA-256 values.
All V9 rows have exact case/frame/arc/update/current-node/target/path identities, final current-node agreement and valid acyclic graph paths.
Every verified traversal has exact endpoints, bounded start/end frames, finite increasing route arcs and inclusive frame-count agreement.
Every inter-node event matches exactly one verified traversal before departure-stub replay; aggregate counts independently agree.
Every frontier target satisfies the frozen TARGET/observed-only planner contract; no historical stub creation timestamp is fabricated from final snapshots.
Source mutation, raw bag/GT/map reads, training, selection and C09/C10 reads are zero.
stop_conditions: Any source state, status, count, schedule, seal, generator or file drift.
Any invalid row, arc, node, stub, path, edge, traversal, event or aggregate.
Any nonstandard run provenance or environment identity.
Any source mutation, bag/GT/map read, training, selection or C09/C10 read.
expected_evidence: Verified sealed 90-case source manifest and provenance.
Recomputed outcome and frozen-scale persistence totals.

estimated_cost.compute: Read-only CPU JSON audit; no simulation, ROS, GPU or bag decompression.
